title: Recorded life in the catchment: GBIF occurrence records (species_occurrences 1.0.0)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe species_occurrences 1.0.0 for Ait Bouguemez valley catchment: of 1141 GBIF occurrence records with a coordinate inside the query polygon, 53 lie outside the catchment, 456 were dropped by licence, and 632 records under CC0 or CC BY 4.0 are kept (544 animals, 88 plants), from 22 datasets, requested on 2026-10-30. Named plants: Astragalus armatus: 0 kept; Thymus satureioides: 0 kept; Thymelaea virgata: 0 kept; Euphorbia nicaeensis: 0 kept. Recorded here, not presence or abundance.

Each record says an organism was recorded at a place and time by someone, as a human observation, a preserved specimen, a fossil specimen, a machine observation or another basis; a fossil specimen records an organism of an earlier age, not a living one. It is not a measurement of presence or abundance: the same species can be common and unrecorded, or rare and recorded often. Records follow where people look. Roads, villages, trails, reserves and the habits of a few observers shape where records fall, and a quiet area is not an empty one. Years reflect recording effort. A rise or fall in records per year follows the arrival of observation apps, surveys and datasets, not the organisms, and the counts by year are not a trend. Coordinates are as recorded with their stated uncertainty, which is missing for some records and larger than the catchment for others; a kept record is inside the catchment polygon at its recorded point only. Only records under CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0 are kept; records under other licences were dropped and are counted, so the kept records are a part of what GBIF holds here. Each dataset is credited to its publisher. The request was made on a stated date; GBIF records are added, corrected and withdrawn over time, so a later request can give other counts. A zero for a named plant means no kept record under that name inside the catchment, not that the plant is absent, and names can be recorded under synonyms.

Siterra science pipeline
providers.processing:lineage: Anonymous reads of the GBIF occurrence search API (4 pages of up to 300 records, the species match and the dataset and organization records) on 2026-10-30, tested against the exact catchment polygon and filtered to CC0 and CC BY 4.0, stored without any field that names a person (science/pipeline/gbif-fetch.py, species-occurrences-bundle.py)

species_occurrences.title: Summary: the request, records read, dropped by polygon and by licence, kept, counts by group, class, basis of record and year, datasets, named plants (the result read_recipe_result returns)

occurrences.title: Kept records as columns (GBIF id, taxon, year, event date, basis of record, latitude, longitude, uncertainty in metres, dataset, licence) joined to taxon, dataset, basis and licence tables

siterra:dataset.access_route: https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search with geometry, hasCoordinate, hasGeospatialIssue and occurrenceStatus (anonymous)
siterra:dataset.resolution_note: Point records with a stated coordinate uncertainty; no grid; one record is one occurrence

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

query_polygon.rule: The frozen polygon buffered by 0.002 degrees (mitred) and simplified at 0.001 degrees, exterior ring only and counter-clockwise: an outward fit for the URL. The run stops unless it contains the frozen polygon. Records are then tested against the exact frozen polygon.

operation_order: Query: GET https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search with geometry = the query polygon (WKT, counter-clockwise exterior ring, 5 decimals), hasCoordinate = true, hasGeospatialIssue = false, occurrenceStatus = PRESENT, limit = 300, offset in steps of 300 until every record is read; no account. Query polygon: the frozen polygon buffered by the configured distance in degrees and simplified at the configured tolerance, an outward fit so that no record inside the frozen polygon can be missed (the run stops unless the query polygon contains the frozen polygon and its text fits the configured length)

Large queries: when the whole query polygon matches more than 10,000 records (the search API pages slowly at deep offsets) it is cut into rectangles by repeated halving until each matches at most 10,000, each part read in pages of 300 with a repeated geometry parameter; a rectangle that still matches more at the smallest size (many records at one point) is split by dataset key and then by year, and the run stops unless the parts add up to its count; the union is the same set and records are deduplicated by GBIF id; the count of unique records read must equal the count GBIF reports for the whole query polygon (read with limit 0)

Keep: a record is kept when its coordinates lie inside or on the exact frozen polygon and its licence is CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0. Every other record is counted, never stored: outside the exact polygon, and by licence (CC BY-NC, unspecified or any other)

Stored per kept record, and only these: GBIF id, scientific name, species, kingdom, class, order, family, year, event date as the record gives it, basis of record, decimal latitude and longitude, coordinate uncertainty in metres (null when the record gives none, never 0), dataset key, dataset title, publisher, licence. No field that names a person (recordedBy, identifiedBy, rights holder and the like) is read into the bundle

Datasets: for each dataset key among the kept records, its title, DOI and publishing organisation from the GBIF dataset and organization endpoints, the kept records per licence, and the attribution line built from them; the attribution of the bundle lists every dataset

Named taxa: each name in the place configuration is matched with GET /v1/species/match (the match, its key, type and status are stored) and queried with the same filters and taxonKey = the match key; the counts (read, outside the polygon, dropped by licence, kept) are stored even when they are zero, with the kept record ids

Summary: the kept records by group (animals = kingdom Animalia, plants = Plantae, fungi = Fungi, other), by class, by basis of record and by year (and records without a year), by dataset, the dropped counts by reason, the records with no coordinate uncertainty and with an uncertainty above 1,000 m

Acceptance checks, all stored with the bundle: the count GBIF reports for the first page equals the records read; every kept record lies inside the exact polygon; every kept record has an allowed licence; the counts by group, basis, class and dataset each add up to the kept records; no stored field names a person; the bundle rebuilds from the stored raw response with identical files apart from the computed time

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: GBIF reports 1141 records for the query on its first page and 1141 unique records were read (equal); 53 lie outside the exact catchment polygon, 456 inside it were dropped by licence (CC-BY-NC-4.0 456), 632 kept; all 632 stored coordinates lie inside or on the polygon; every stored licence is CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 (True); the counts by group, basis of record, class and dataset each add up to 632 ({'group': 632, 'basis': 632, 'class': 632, 'dataset': 632}); no stored text carries a person field name (none); the build run twice from the stored raw response gives identical records: True.

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Coordinates are decimal degrees (GBIF decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude, WGS84), 6 decimals; uncertainty_m is metres as the record states it; year is a calendar year; a record count is one GBIF occurrence, not an individual organism.

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: A record without a coordinate uncertainty or a year stores null: 575 of 632 have no uncertainty and 24 no year; 0 state an uncertainty of exactly 0 m and are stored as stated. A named plant with no kept record is reported as 0 with its match, never omitted.

siterra:checks.name: qa_join_coverage
siterra:checks.detail: Every kept record joins to one taxon, one dataset, one basis of record and one licence; 179 taxa, 22 datasets with their title, publisher and DOI; GBIF datasets read 34, publishers 21.

siterra:checks.name: period_alignment
siterra:checks.detail: Where a record gives both a year and an event date the year equals the first four characters of the date: 0 differ. Years run 1864 to 2025; counts by year reflect recording effort.

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present
siterra:checks.detail: siterra:attribution holds one line for each of the 22 datasets (publisher, title, records kept, licence, DOI, access date) and the GBIF line.

siterra:checks.name: visual_inspection_sample
siterra:checks.detail: Read on 2026-10-30: the summary (632 kept records, 544 animals and 88 plants, 22 datasets; 503 of the records come from one bird-observation dataset, so the animal count follows where and when birders recorded) and four stored records (two eBird records of the same bird at one point on neighbouring days in 2012, a 2021 eBird record, a 2025 iNaturalist record with 5 m uncertainty); no stored field or dataset title names a person; the four named plants give zero kept records (Thymus satureioides and Euphorbia nicaeensis each have one record under CC BY-NC, dropped by licence; Thymus satureioides matched GBIF's accepted spelling Thymus saturejoides, a FUZZY match, stored as such); 575 of 632 records give no coordinate uncertainty and 6 give more than 1,000 m.
